properties.name: baseframework.security.enabled
properties.description: Whether the framework's default HTTP Basic security filter chain is enabled. When false, all requests are permitted (intended for local development or gateway-handled security).

properties.name: baseframework.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Opt-in flag that activates the framework's Kafka consumer/producer factories and KafkaTemplate.

properties.name: baseframework.jpa.auditing.enabled
properties.description: Whether Spring Data JPA auditing (createdAt/updatedAt population) is enabled.

properties.name: baseframework.openapi.title
properties.description: Title shown in the generated OpenAPI document and Swagger UI.

properties.name: baseframework.openapi.description
properties.description: Description shown in the generated OpenAPI document.

properties.name: baseframework.openapi.version
properties.description: Version label shown in the generated OpenAPI document.
